social:piasnews-social-e8a0cb2356a36478:.zh: 问：还有很多可以争取的，不是吗？“是的，当然。我觉得我们、Ferrari和Mercedes之间会很接近，所以是的。关键就在于填补那些最后的细节和差距，看看我们能做些什么！”

social:piasnews-social-a731f8ee61efe3e9:.source_text: Q: Were you disappointed that maybe a little bit more pace didn't come out of the car? "A little bit, yeah. I think just the soft lap wasn't quite as good. I feel like it's often the case this year, that you put the soft tyre on and it's not quite as nice as the balance you have on the medium.
